requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-3734-4231-5929--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Phyrexian Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

2023-4518-5295-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4613-4687-8190.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Loot has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-4687-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
4613-4687-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Loot using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.

1486-1744-2972-4836.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Ganax.
When the Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, each Ganax triggers five times, creating 25 Treasure tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for a Dragon card and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, each Ganax triggers, creating six Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3 until you have no Dragons remaining in your library.
1486-1744-2972-4836.notes: This combo will make some extra Treasures which you may use to activate Magda's ability a few extra times to fetch a few artifacts.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7606.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, it's innate ability and persist ability each trigger.
Resolve the trigger from Rampant Rejuvenator's innate ability, allowing you to search your library for a number of basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Rampant Rejuvenator from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3693-7315.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-7315.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1456-3713-4474-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3912-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Khalni Garden.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-5007-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Morselhoarder enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat.

1117-3689-5060-6518.notablePrerequisites: There is a [type] card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1117-3689-5060-6518.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3025-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
3025-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

1274-2086-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3764-4871-5256.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1115-1563-2457-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2607-6439.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control have total toughness 40 or greater.
2607-6439.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Betor and Archfiend of Despair trigger.
Resolve the Betor trigger, causing each opponent to half their life total, rounded up.
Resolve the Archfiend of Despair trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.

1339-4871-6275.notablePrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have max speed.
1339-4871-6275.description:
Activate Gas Guzzler by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gas Guzzler ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4885-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
4885-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

2665-4823-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Timeless Witness.
2665-4823-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness.
When the token Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-1575-2438-5903.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other artifact.
856-1575-2438-5903.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat.

486-3628-4836-5159.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Lunar Force to become an artifact until end of turn.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Lunar Force that is a 4/4 artifact creature named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
At the beginning of your end step, Mishra's Warform triggers, causing you to fail to sacrifice Mishra's Warform due to The Master.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, Mishra's Warform triggers, countering that spell and causing you to fail to sacrifice it due to The Master.
Repeat step 4 as necessary.

1549-1558-4840.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Virtue of Persistence triggers, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1385-2034-2530-2946.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1385-2034-2530-2946.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {C}{C}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Cult Conscript enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

2203-2645-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five mana-producing lands.
2203-2645-4657.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Vorinclex's first ability triggers five times, adding at least {5}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping five lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

596-1168-1651-1737.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Darksteel Citadel.
The Darksteel Citadel token enters the battlefield, triggering Toggo, creating a Rock artifact equipment token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Darksteel Citadel token and the Rock token, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1430-4112.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying {2}{U}.
Mirror Image enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mirror Image triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

147-536-4276.notablePrerequisites: Other lands that can produce {2}{U}{R}{R} on the battlefield.
147-536-4276.description:
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting any land you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Turnabout.
Holding priority, activate Riptide Laboratory by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Dualcaster Mage to your hand.
Resolve the Turnabout copy, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat from step 2.

4828-5089-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
4828-5089-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
4828-5089-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

79-4013-4893.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer's ability by paying {C}, blinking Birthing Hulk.
Birthing Hulk enters the battlefield tapped, triggering itself, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may activate any number of them.
